title: 'Storefront' sign band floats unattached above the roofline in both implementations
evidence:
+    add_cube(name + "_roof", (0, 0, 0.19), (bw * 1.08, bd * 1.08, 0.06), mat_hex(name + "_roof", SMALL_BIZ_ROOF))
+    add_cube(name + "_sign", (0, -bd * 0.52, 0.245), (bw * 0.72, 0.09, 0.012), mat_hex(name + "_sign", CREAM))
+    add_quad(name + "_sign", (bx, by - bd * 0.52, bh + 0.11 * scale), (bw * 0.72, 0.09 * scale),
+             sign_m, parent=parent)
detail: Roof top is z=0.22 and walls end 0.16; the sign spans z 0.239–0.251, touching nothing — a band floating above the parapet, not a storefront. pp_lib repeats it (sign z=bh+0.11 vs roof top bh+0.06).
recommended_fix: Seat the band on the parapet (bottom at roof top) or mount it lower on the facade; mirror the correction in both build_small_biz and make_small_biz.

title: b_small_biz duplicates b_finance's exact hex
detail: New palette key b_small_biz reuses b_finance's exact hex (#9C8C6C) with no reuse note. If deliberate it deserves a comment; otherwise any finance-colored terminal renders visually identical to small_biz.
recommended_fix: Alias b_small_biz to b_finance with an explicit reuse comment, or pick a distinct warm-stone hex in both pp_lib.py and gen_sprites.py.

title: make_small_biz roof panel and AC unit float above the roof slab
evidence:
+    add_cube(name + "_roof", (bx, by, bh + 0.03 * scale), (bw * 1.08, bd * 1.08, 0.06 * scale), top_m, parent)
+    add_cube(name + "_panel", (bx, by, bh + 0.09 * scale), (bw * 0.80, bd * 0.80, 0.02 * scale), panel_m, parent)
+    add_cube(name + "_acu", (bx + 0.26 * scale, by - 0.16 * scale, bh + 0.12 * scale),
+             (0.22 * scale, 0.18 * scale, 0.08 * scale), top_m, parent)
detail: With bh=0.34 the roof spans z 0.34–0.40; panel bottom is 0.42 and ACU bottom 0.42 — both hover 0.02 above the slab. gen_sprites grounds its equivalents correctly.
recommended_fix: Center the panel at bh+0.07*scale and the ACU at bh+0.10*scale so their bottoms rest on the roof top (bh+0.06).

title: Shape constants duplicated across pp_lib and gen_sprites already diverge
evidence:
+    bw, bd, bh = 1.10 * scale, 0.84 * scale, 0.34 * scale
+    add_cube(name + "_walls", (0, 0, 0.08), (bw, bd, 0.16), mat_hex(name + "_body", SMALL_BIZ_BODY, shade=0.62))
+    panel_m = emissive_mat(name + "_panel", pal["b_small_biz_roof"], pal["body_str"] * 0.80)
+    add_cube(name + "_panel", (0, 0, 0.225), (bw * 0.80, bd * 0.80, 0.012), mat_hex(name + "_panel", SMALL_BIZ_ROOF, shade=0.90))
detail: Each new shape exists twice with mismatched constants: wall height 0.34 vs 0.16, panel shade 0.80 vs 0.90, wing shade 0.85 vs 0.90. Nothing in the diff declares which implementation is canonical.
recommended_fix: Share one source of truth — a constants module, or pp_lib consumed by gen_sprites — so the blend scene and the sprite cannot silently diverge.

title: make_campus creates a '_sign' material used only by the clock tower
evidence:
+    sign_m = emissive_mat(name + "_sign", pal["canvas"], pal["body_str"])
+    add_cube(name + "_tower", (bx, by + 0.30 * scale, bh + 0.10 * scale), (0.16 * scale, 0.16 * scale, 0.16 * scale), sign_m, parent)
detail: sign_m is created as name+'_sign' but its only consumer is the clock tower; the campus has no sign element. build_campus names the equivalent material '_tower' correctly.
recommended_fix: Rename to tower_m = emissive_mat(name + "_tower", ...) to match gen_sprites naming and the element it actually colors.

title: Style drift: semicolon-joined statements and a stray third blank line
evidence:
+    build_small_biz("small_biz"); names.append("small_biz")
+    build_campus("campus"); names.append("campus")
+    return parent
+
+
+
 # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
detail: Semicolon-joined statements break gen_sprites' one-statement-per-line convention; pp_lib closes make_campus with three blank lines where two (as after make_small_biz) is the norm.
recommended_fix: Split each build/append pair onto two lines; delete the extra blank line after make_campus.
